fields.why: Every outcome quantity is reported by fluoridation status (Tables 1-2). A's 'summary' evidence is only the count of included parishes and children, which is a description of the sample, not a summarized outcome.

The outcome is treatment cost and the report estimates cost savings ($36.28 per child; $1.4 million a year), so cost/economic fits best. A's 'cross-sectional' (a single year of claims) can be defended but adds little to 'ecologic'.

agreed_errors.why: The text reports crude contrasts for the same exposure-outcome pair: cost per eligible child in NF parishes was 'approximately twice as high', with Table 1 group means. The brief counts a crude ratio as true.
